settings.heading:
Stand apart.
Quietly.
settings.text: Fitted Mediterranean menswear designed to make an impression without shouting for it.
Guillo creates fitted menswear for men who prefer to stand apart without dressing loudly.
Sits close through the leg with room drafted into the seat and thigh, then tapers cleanly below the knee.
A touch more ease through the leg, with a side fastening that keeps the front clean under an untucked shirt.

settings.name: The Alassio Linen Pants
settings.text: Linen pique cut for comfort rather than compression. Room straight down the leg.

settings.heading: Built around fit.
settings.text: Most menswear is drafted to fit everyone. Guillo is drafted to follow the body, with room where the body needs it and a clean line everywhere else.

settings.statement:
Guillo started because I was tired of menswear that either fitted badly or looked like everything else.
I wanted clothes that followed the body properly, had more character, and took influence from the way men dress around the Mediterranean without becoming loud or overdone.
settings.text: So we cut our own. Fitted through the body, with the ease and colour of the Mediterranean in it, and nothing on it that shouts. Brought to life in Brisbane, made in small runs, and worn hard before it reaches the site.
